sourceTitle: Interim strategy requirements: land application of biosolids containing PFAS
explanation: Michigan's 2024 interim strategy classifies biosolids using dry-weight PFOS and PFOA concentrations. This classification does not replace Part 24, permit, RMP, agronomic, or site-specific requirements.

rules.explanation: PFOS or PFOA at 100 µg/kg dry weight or higher is industrially impacted and cannot be land applied.
PFOS or PFOA at 20 µg/kg dry weight or higher, with both below 100 µg/kg, is elevated.
PFOS and PFOA both below 20 µg/kg dry weight are below the additional PFAS action thresholds.

requirements.title: Submit results to EGLE
requirements.detail: Submit the PFAS sample results through MiEnviro at least two weeks before land application.
requirements.timing: At least 14 days before land application

requirements.title: Notify the WRD Biosolids Program
requirements.detail: Notify Water Resources Division Biosolids Program staff of the PFAS results by submitting them through MiEnviro.

requirements.title: Share results with the landowner and farmer
requirements.detail: Provide the PFOS and PFOA results and Michigan PFAS biosolids information before land application.

requirements.title: Limit the application rate
requirements.detail: Use no more than 1.5 dry tons per acre unless EGLE approves an alternative risk-mitigation strategy submitted at least 14 days before land application.

requirements.title: Sample the source effluent
requirements.detail: Collect a PFAS sample from the biosolids source effluent.

requirements.title: Start a source-reduction plan
requirements.detail: Investigate potential PFOS and PFOA sources to the sanitary wastewater and resulting biosolids.

requirements.title: Do not land apply this batch
requirements.detail: The interim strategy deems this batch industrially impacted and prohibits land application.

requirements.title: Arrange alternative management
requirements.detail: Arrange alternative treatment or disposal of the solids.
